status: frozen future contract; implementation prohibited before phase 4 approval
required_features: multiple media and months per cart
design/print/install per rental line and month
activation_gates: At least one real pilot project and verified inventory
Real photos, coordinates, rates and availability owner
Security, privacy, SEO and accessibility QA passed
must_not_require: building CRM or ticketing before their own approved phases

public_user: may view approved introductory rental content
may view approved media/project summaries without sensitive rate or availability data
authenticated_customer: may view rental prices when enabled
may view published availability calendar when enabled
may see protected allocations assigned to the same customer
manager: may keep future periods internal before annual calendar publication
may create protected allocation for selected customer
may set expiry, reason and release status

publication_model.unauthenticated_response: do not expose prices or availability payloads; return login-required policy response
publication_model.protected_hold_behavior: blocks other customers and is visible only to assigned customer and authorized staff
publication_model.public_release: explicit manager publication action; never inferred from data existence

phase1_only_requirements: reserve plugin namespace and feature flags
register ProtectedAllocation and CalendarPublication in architecture
do not build inventory, map, calendar, reservation or admin UI
